scope: toy binary fields N=12-21, 90 curves; exact counts
statement: On y^2+xy=x^3+ax^2+b over F_{2^N}, N=dn, Tr(a)=0: a valid T-stable line u*F_q exists iff Tr_{N/d}(b^{1/4})=0 and is then b^{1/4}F_q (48/90 curves, 0 mismatches); on all 48, x(P+T)=sqrt(b)/x(P) maps the line to itself. Post hoc, signed-vector rows per column on that line are 1.76-2.89x the standard line, and 0.54-0.56 (n=3) / 0.28-0.29 (n=4) of other valid lines.
